tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other TheTendereshouldbeamanufacturerwhomusthavemanufactured,testedandsuppliedthe equipment (s) /goods similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements Automatic cloth bag vending machine along with 500 bags upto at least 80%of the quantity required (02 Nos of Machine) in any one of the last 03 completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), for Micro and small enterprises 40% of the quantity required (01 Nos of Machine) in any one of the last 02 completed financial years (i.e financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26) Automatic smart reverse vending machine for vouchers along with 500 vouchers upto at least 80%of the quantity required (06 Nos of Machine) in any one of the last 03 completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), for Micro and small enterprises 40% of the quantity required (03 Nos of Machine) in any one of the last 02 completed financial years (i.e financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26).The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after and be in satisfactory operation for 12 months continuously. The work completion/performance certificate shall be duly signed by an officer of the rank of Executive Engineer or an equivalent cadre or above. Certificates signed by officers below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall not be considered and shall be rejected.

The Tenderershouldbe the Original Equipment/Goods Manufacturer(OEM) or an authorizeddealerof the OEM. Company Registration Certificate. GST Registration Certificate. PAN Card. OEM Authorization Letter (if bidder is not the manufacturer). Valid dealership/distributorship certificate (where applicable
The bidder shall furnish an undertaking specifying to supply spare parts for a minimum period of five (5) years after completion of the warranty period

The bidder shall submit a self-declaration (The bidder shall not been Blacklisted/Debarred/Banned/etc by any Central Government Department, State Government Department, PSU, Municipal Corporation or Autonomous Body during the last three years.)
The bidder should have valid ISO or IATF certificates. If the bidder is authorized Dealer, certificates of the OEM will be considered
